task_description: Predict t+1 velocity (u, v) from t velocity (u, v)

metrics_explanation.mse: Mean Squared Error - lower is better
metrics_explanation.rmse: Root Mean Squared Error - lower is better
metrics_explanation.mae: Mean Absolute Error - lower is better
metrics_explanation.mape: Mean Absolute Percentage Error (%) - lower is better
metrics_explanation.normalized: Metrics computed on normalized data (0-1 range)
metrics_explanation.denormalized: Metrics computed on actual velocity values
